source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Read the report.
3. Locate where and when the brake tester was used for vehicular brake tests.
4. Make a note of the time period in which the braking is carried out.
5. Enter the recorded data into your system.
6. Documents failed braking results or information that is not legible.
7. Document the vehicle license plate number of the inspected vehicle.
8. Document the date on which the inspection was performed.
9. Discard the original document and use the digital copy whenever required.
